column3: MT 4:28. “They are saying to you” is rendered “to you it is declared”; “kingdom” is rendered “sovereignty.”
MT 4:29. “They will feed you” is rendered “You will be given … to eat”; “seven times” is rendered “seven periods of time.”
MT 4:30. “At that moment” is rendered “Immediately”; NASB supplies “feathers” and “claws.”
MT 4:32. “Strike on his hand” is rendered “ward off His hand.”
MT 4:33. NASB restructures the clause “for the honor of my kingdom”; “kingdom” is rendered “sovereignty.”
MT 4:34. “Lifting up” is rendered “exalt,” and “bring low” “humble.”
